research_units: A future aggregation script/file should compute per-class pass/fail counts from immutable evidence rather than manually maintained claims.
The state summary should carry only current pointers and boundary conclusions, keeping raw experiment history append-only.
Once enough close-overhead samples exist, report median plus upper-tail/max to choose reserve.
A practical stopping criterion may be needed if no runtime failure is observed at increasingly long classes; until then report a lower bound only.
Provider behavior may impose a soft/variable ceiling rather than deterministic timeout, so repeated validation near the candidate cap is essential.
The final relay policy should optimize expected useful throughput, not chase the largest one-off successful duration.
